summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed Form 6-K on 28 August 2026 solely to disclose that its Chief Financial Officer, William Chalmers, sold 9,100,000 ordinary shares at an average price of 111.5861 pence per share on 27 August 2026 on the London Stock Exchange. The filing is a routine PDMR shareholding notification required by UK Market Abuse Regulation and SEC rules for foreign private issuers. There is no strategic corporate event, board action, or advisor involved. The transaction is ordinary portfolio management by an insider, not a tender offer, buyback, or restructuring. What to watch: no further regulatory or deal-related developments are anticipated from this routine disclosure.
